facts.fact: Africa50 and Bayobab (MTN) announced in May 2023 a partnership to develop Project East2West, a terrestrial fibre network across ten or more countries including Kenya, Uganda, Rwanda and Tanzania, connecting landlocked countries to subsea cables, with Africa50 investing construction equity; Africa50's ticket is imputed, not disclosed, and the record dates the deal 2023 (Africa50 approval 21 July 2023).
